objectives.text: Restrict endpoints by path, method and role with authorizeHttpRequests in a SecurityFilterChain bean
Predict 401 versus 403 for an unauthenticated request and an authenticated request without the required role
Test protected endpoints with MockMvc and Spring Security's test support for an anonymous user and users with different roles

minutes.basis: intake planning model under the new-course budget rule (workflow/docs/tools/validators.md, Reading time): no artifact.html exists yet, so modeledP50 is the intake target for a core page (9 minutes) and modeledWorstPath adds 2.5 minutes for the worst required route (two wrong graded attempts and wrong-first explores per interactive unit; course-1 measured worst-path gaps were 2.41-2.65 minutes above P50). budget = aboutLabel = ceil(max(modeledP50, modeledWorstPath)) = 12. The api-security module PR replaces modeledP50 with the frozen estimator P50 (workflow/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py, sha256 0deca96bf5e367aeae51a82abdbd4b6ce0d0289ecc9868c9eff3701016edf96f) on the authored bytes, re-models the worst path, and keeps budget at least ceil(max(P50, worst path)) and at most 15; T14 then checks the day totals. See workflow/evidence/spring-boot/intake.md, section Minute budgets.
